changelog:
fetch-legionclaw-invite-code 1.0.0

- Initial release: fetches Tongfudun LegionClaw usage-permission invite codes by POSTing agentid-derived userId.
- Supports single or multiple code requests; returns all codes inline in chat by default.
- Handles both three- and four-segment session handles; always parses agentid as the second segment.
- Only uses files for delivery if explicitly requested by the user.
- Friendly error wording and detailed permission handling built in.
- Designed for and intended to be run as a LegionClaw-hosted agent.
